mapper.sql: t.id, t.transaction_no, t.transaction_type, t.company_id, d.dept_name AS company_name, t.project_id, t.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, l.zone_id, z.zone_name, t.location_id, l.location_code, l.location_name, t.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.specification, u.unit_name AS base_unit_name, u.symbol AS base_unit_symbol, t.quantity_before, t.quantity_change, t.quantity_after, t.locked_before, t.locked_change, t.locked_after, t.source_type, t.source_id, t.source_no, t.occurred_at, t.operator_id, su.nick_name AS operator_name, t.remark
